$comment: Canonical status source for the unpingable site. Edit here, then run tools/render_status.py to regenerate the ledger block in index.html. Every row must cite public evidence; the verified field is the date the cited evidence was written or the check was run, never today’s date by default.
generated_note: Rendered into index.html by tools/render_status.py. Do not hand-edit the ledger block.

objects.name: Four-office governed vertical
objects.claim: Four separately-owned offices carried one bounded Git change from proposal to evaluated testimony without any office absorbing another’s jurisdiction, and without code changes in any office.
objects.verified_by: the four offices’ own dated status statements, and the pilot declaration document — itself the governed effect the pilot executed
objects.promotion: A public, reproducible pair of artifacts — one admitted scenario and one refused scenario — that a stranger can obtain without private custody. Today the pilot’s identifiers, digests and verdicts exist only in a private campaign record; the public surface is the declaration and the offices’ own status statements.

objects.name: Docket (governed work runtime)
objects.status: working runtime, audited baseline; not production-hardened
objects.claim: Exactly one effect class is admitted — the atomic Git target-ref transition. A proposal outside it refuses with a typed refusal before any standing is issued, any reservation created, any dispatch identity minted, or any provider runs.
objects.verified_by: the gwr-greenfield-v0.1 freeze: 125 tests, four gates exiting 0 in both debug and release profiles
objects.promotion: Three trust-model premises are load-bearing assumptions rather than enforced guarantees: exclusive broker custody of the governed ref, same-UID trust of the provider and broker binaries, and monotone clock readings. Operator-ready packaging does not exist; there is a source-install path, not a published-package promise.

objects.name: AG ng (authority office)
objects.status: exercised by the vertical; explicitly not production deployable
objects.claim: Decides whether exact prepared work may receive authority, and burns one-use decision authority. It does not own the wire contracts, execution, settlement, claim admissibility, or orchestration.
objects.verified_by: its issuance path authorized both the three-office vertical (2026-07-25) and the four-office pilot (2026-07-26)
objects.promotion: Its own production-deployability checklist closes. The issuance surface is a library face exercised by harness, and the decision-burn ledger is in-memory per process.

objects.name: NQ (testimony, claims, reliance)
objects.claim: Pulls bounded evidence, keeps loss of observability visible rather than silently healthy, and emits testimony and typed refusals — never actions. A clean receipt approves no merge, deployment, restart, or incident closure.
objects.verified_by: its own dated status statement and compatibility policy
objects.promotion: Consumer identity is configured, not authenticated. NQ stays pre-1.0; the office designation is a jurisdiction statement, not a stability promise.

objects.name: Night Shift (proposal and read-only orchestration)
objects.status: part of the exercised vertical; not operator-ready
objects.claim: Proposes bounded intent behind a gate-enforced no-actuation boundary. Its proposals bind intent only — never file lists, content bytes, or authority.
objects.verified_by: its own dated status statement; the four-office pilot ran against this repository as its target
objects.promotion: File-granular proposals are a library face, and the deployment files are reference scaffolding rather than a packaged service.

objects.name: The stale-yes refusal
objects.claim: A permission valid when checked refuses at exercise time because the gap between observation and exercise exceeded its bound on a named monotonic basis — and no capacity is spent.
objects.verified_by: ./demo/refused-spend.sh run against an editable install of the tree at agent_gov 485e557 — exit 0, integrity tripwire green. Not a cold clone.
objects.promotion: Re-verify from a genuinely cold clone, and pin the captured output rather than the receipt id. The id is a function of the receipt schema: it moved from dda5a1e5… to 3f8b93c1… when schema fields were added, while the behaviour it attests did not change.

objects.name: agent_governor (classic Python)
objects.claim: Still the custody home of the frozen conformance corpus and of the bounded diagnostic drill helpers Night Shift imports; no authority, policy decision, credential, or capability crosses that wire.
objects.promotion: Not applicable. New authority work lives in AG ng, with no wire compatibility between the two, and none implied.

objects.name: The declared-deny probe
objects.claim: A firewall’s declared deny rule and an observed path are held apart and never merged into one story. The frozen probe exercises its witness path against real pfSense substrate in a controlled lab.
objects.verified_by: a self-built pfSense CE lab with a controlled deny rule, a benign subject, a passing control probe, and captured teardown
objects.promotion: The probe has never caught a real firewall failing to enforce a real block. It has shown it would notice. Promotion needs live testimony from a real estate; the lab supplies compatibility evidence, not deployment evidence.

objects.name: The authored design layer
objects.claim: The tools operate over a system someone composed on purpose. That composition is currently unwritten: it lives in doctrine and in the operator’s head, and every tool re-derives it by hand.
objects.verified_by: Nothing to verify. There is no implementation, no schema, and no wire format.
objects.promotion: A forcing case that a hand-derived composition demonstrably cannot serve, plus a ratified revision format that at least two tools can consume. The filing is a handle for review, not authorization to build.
